tools.name: websets_searches_websets-create
tools.description: Creates a new Search for the Webset. The default behavior is to reuse the previous Search results and evaluate them against the new criteria. Required: webset, count, query. Optional: behavior (default: override), criteria, entity (plus 5 more). Returns the new WebsetSearch.

params.name: webset
params.description: The id of the Webset

params.name: behavior
params.description: How this search interacts with existing items in the Webset: - **override**: Replace existing items and evaluate all items against new criteria - **append**: Add new items to existing ones, keeping items that match the new criteria

params.name: count
params.description: Number of Items the Search will attempt to find. The actual number of Items found may be less than this number depending on the query complexity.

params.name: criteria
params.description: Criteria every item is evaluated against. It's not required to provide your own criteria, we automatically detect the criteria from all the information provided in the query. Only use this when you need more fine control.

params.name: entity
params.description: Entity the search will return results for. It is not required to provide it, we automatically detect the entity from all the information provided in the query. Only use this when you need more fine control.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Sources (existing imports or websets) to exclude from search results. Any results found within these sources will be omitted to prevent finding them during search.

params.name: maxPeoplePerCompany
params.description: Optional soft cap for people searches. When set, the search will try to include at most this many matching people from the same current employer company.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Set of key-value pairs you want to associate with this object.

params.name: query
params.description: Natural language search query describing what you are looking for. Be specific and descriptive about your requirements, characteristics, and any constraints that help narrow down the results. Any URLs provided will be crawled and used as additional context for the search.

params.name: recall
params.description: Whether to provide an estimate of how many total relevant results could exist for this search. Result of the analysis will be available in the `recall` field within the search request.

params.name: scope
params.description: Limit the search to specific sources (existing imports). Any results found within these sources matching the search criteria will be included in the Webset.
